method.source: All648 prepared consumed clips; reconstruct/verify exact input bytes and actual native clock.
method.truth: AI source-frame presence requires publisher AI label, insertion into the known interval, and an actual decoded RGB change from the original. Ordinary controls remain genuine even when pixels change. No identified-face/pixel-authorship truth.
method.connections: Seed original known source/donor/byte components. Join groups sharing an exactly equal nonuniform decoded RGB frame among predeclared model input frames. Uniform color frames are not identity/source links.
method.roles: Preserve original roles if every refined component stays inside one role. If any component crosses roles, reassign all refined components in salted-hash order round-robin before any authenticity inference. No scores choose roles.
method.local: Recompute sampled local labels from actual changed-frame indices; preserve full-clip truth and unobserved-edited-frame count separately.

limits: Actual RGB difference and publisher source labels, not identity/pixel authorship or detection quality. Source groups/people/pretraining may have unknown connections.
